title: When the Ember Sings
author: Paloma Whitlock
blurb: Lena Joubert, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
